process_steps.description: Fed-batch mammalian cell culture at 15,000 L working volume; the only step of the drug substance process at which product-quality attributes are formed.

source_references.quote: The step forms the three glycan attributes, the charge variant distribution and the aggregate level of the harvested pool.
The culture is inoculated from the N-1 seed bioreactor, fed with a single nutrient feed during the run and harvested after about 17 days.
The studies were executed on bench scale stirred tank bioreactors qualified as a model of the commercial vessel under SOP-1001.

design_spaces.definition: The part of the characterized region in culture pH, culture temperature, culture duration and dissolved CO2 within which the fitted response-surface models predict every measured attribute inside its in-process limit. It is smaller than the characterized region, and galactosylation is the attribute that excludes most of it.

statements.statement_text: Culture pH, temperature, dissolved CO2, osmolality and culture duration are classified WC-CPP.

source_references.quote: Of the 9 parameters, 5 were classified as well controlled critical process parameters, 3 as key process parameters and 1 as a general process parameter.

statements.statement_text: The five attributes measured as responses of the designed experiments are afucosylation, galactosylation, high mannose, acidic charge variants and aggregate.

source_references.quote: The step forms the three glycan attributes, the charge variant distribution and the aggregate level of the harvested pool.

statements.statement_text: Within the design space the fitted response-surface models predict every measured attribute inside its in-process limit.

source_references.quote: The design space is the region of the four modelled parameters over which every attribute governed here meets its in-process criterion.

statements.statement_text: The response-surface models describe the characterized region adequately and every overall F test reaches significance.

source_references.quote: The response-surface models account for between 91 and 97 % of the variance in the five responses.

statements.statement_text: There was no significant lack of fit relative to the center-point pure error.

source_references.quote: No response shows significant lack of fit against the centre-point pure error.

statements.statement_text: All bioreactor-set CQAs meet acceptance with margin at commercial scale.

source_references.quote: All 7 quality attributes set at this step meet their drug substance acceptance criteria at commercial scale in a simulation of 2,000 batches.
